name: Dialpad Meetings
description_en:
Dialpad Meetings provides browser/app video meetings with collaboration controls and optional AI-related meeting records. Its Free and Business meeting licences are distinct from the broader Dialpad Connect, Support and Sell products.

A company using Dialpad accounts may manage meeting entitlements and billing in the parent application. The price of a general communications suite should not be presented as an independently verified standalone Meetings price.
description_zh:
Dialpad Meetings 提供浏览器/应用视频会议、协作控制及可选 AI 会议记录。Free 和 Business 会议许可不同于更广的 Dialpad Connect、Support、Sell。

使用 Dialpad 账户的公司，可能在父应用管理会议权益及账单，不能把通用通信套件价格当作已核实的独立 Meetings 价格。

core_features.explanation_en: Join meetings and use waiting-room, password and moderation settings.
core_features.explanation_zh: 加入会议并使用等候室、密码及主持设置。

core_features.explanation_en: Recording/transcription requires mandatory notification; access varies by licence.
core_features.explanation_zh: 录制/转写有强制通知，访问按许可不同。

en: Choose the organizer account, verify its meeting licence, set guest admission and share the meeting link. Test a browser permission denial, guest waiting room and screen sharing before the client session. The FAQ lists Business at 150 participants and five hours, with an explicit Connect/Support condition when used through a Dialpad account. Those are conditional limits, not Free-plan promises.
zh: 选择组织者账户、核实会议许可、设置访客进入并分享链接。客户会议前应测试浏览器拒绝权限、访客等候室及共享。FAQ 列 Business 150 人和五小时，通过 Dialpad 账户使用时还明确附 Connect/Support 条件，不能当作 Free 承诺。

sections.title_en: Example: a client review with external guests
sections.title_zh: 示例：含外部访客的客户审查
sections.en:
Choose the organizer account, verify its meeting licence, set guest admission and share the meeting link. Test a browser permission denial, guest waiting room and screen sharing before the client session. The FAQ lists Business at 150 participants and five hours, with an explicit Connect/Support condition when used through a Dialpad account. Those are conditional limits, not Free-plan promises.

Recording/transcription notifications are mandatory; decide participant access and consent before enabling capture. No meeting or AI recap was tested.
sections.zh:
选择组织者账户、核实会议许可、设置访客进入并分享链接。客户会议前应测试浏览器拒绝权限、访客等候室及共享。FAQ 列 Business 150 人和五小时，通过 Dialpad 账户使用时还明确附 Connect/Support 条件，不能当作 Free 承诺。

录制/转写通知强制提供，启用采集前应明确参与者访问和同意。未测试会议或 AI 摘要。

sections.title_en: Check the actual licence purchase preview
sections.title_zh: 核对实际许可购买预览
sections.en:
The billing guide instructs a Free user to choose Upgrade, licence quantity and payment method, then Preview Purchase. It does not publish a universally payable Business amount in the read guide, so that figure remains unknown. Parent-managed accounts show billing in Dialpad instead. Switching monthly to annual requires Customer Care and charges twelve months on the next billing date; annual renewal recurs.

Participants may still incur carrier long-distance charges. Large Meetings is a separate entitlement and the homepage’s larger capacity should not override ordinary Business limits without checking the add-on.
sections.zh:
账单指南要求 Free 用户选择升级、许可数量及付款方式，再预览购买，但已读指南未公布通用 Business 应付金额，因此保留未知。父账户管理者在 Dialpad 查看账单。月付转年付需客户支持，下一账单日收十二个月，年付会续期。

参与者仍可能产生运营商长途费。Large Meetings 是独立权益，未经附加项核对，不能用首页更大容量覆盖普通 Business 上限。

sections.en:
Teams needing ordinary remote reviews can evaluate Meetings separately from a contact center. Diagnose permission, licence and organizer state before assuming an unavailable option is a service outage. A successful call does not prove a transcript or recording was retained.

No device, carrier billing, AI accuracy, recording access, software licence, self-hosted distribution or recovery was verified. Commercial prices and current add-on limits require the active account.
sections.zh:
需要常规远程审查的团队可将 Meetings 与呼叫中心分别评估。选项不可用时，先检查权限、许可及组织者状态，不能直接判定服务事故。通话成功不证明转写或录制已保留。

未核实设备、运营商账单、AI 准确性、录制访问、软件许可、自托管发行版或恢复。商业价格及当前附加限制需账户确认。

research_gaps.en: Standalone Business price, Free limits, Large Meetings scope, recording/AI and recovery remain account-specific and untested.
research_gaps.zh: 独立 Business 价格、Free 限制、Large Meetings 范围、录制/AI 及恢复依账户且未测试。
